Remote tab · the model list, 30 / 70

2 Oct 2026 · two designs · real page, pretend service with your model names · 1 / 2 or ← → · click a picture for full size

Design 1 · All at once

The model list is 30% of the page, the model's details 70%.

Every model is a one-line card: its place in the category, its name, its size, and the green dot (loaded) or ✔ / ✗ (tried).

Two columns, every category open: all 25 models at once, no scrolling.

To fit, the chips (tools, big, long context…) move to the model's tabs and the card's tooltip, and :latest is left off the names. The full name is in the details.

At your window size no name is cut. At 1466 wide, 4–5 long names end in "…".

Try it live: Design 1 on the real page (open while this session runs it)

Design 2 · One category at a time

The same 30 / 70 split.

The categories are buttons over the list: Coding 7 · Thinking 2 · Pictures 3 · General chat 7 · Helpers 2 · Not listed 4. Click one to see its models.

The models show as full cards (name, size, file, chips, marks), biggest first. The largest category has 7, so it always fits without scrolling.

Typing in Find looks through every category at once.

You see fewer models at a time, but each card says more, and nothing is cut.
